answer_1.quote: Automatic text summarization aims to distill the most salient content of a given text in a compact form.

answer_2.quote: Unless otherwise stated, all results reported are ROUGE-1/2/L.

answer_4.quote: We collect human judgment annotations for two of the four quality dimensions studied in , namely consistency and relevance.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators see the source article and randomly‑ordered model outputs and rate each summary for relevance and consistency on a Likert scale from 1 to 5.
